result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual, aspirational headers followed by associate anecdotes that illustrate values rather than stating policy. Shareholders are addressed first with an absolute commitment, 'We are committed to providing it.' Voice is collective 'we', with third-person storytelling. Commitments are often framed as necessity ('we must'), and the page leans on named, headline-led value sections.
